Name: Farm Cave Spawns More Tree Fruit
Author: atravita
Description:
Modded farm caves don't really play well with how the fruit cave spawns its fruits. In vanilla, each tile has an equal chance to be picked for a spawn, and for modded caves that have large amounts of void in order to implement separate "rooms", it's quite likely that the tile picked is a void tile and nothing will be spawned. This is an attempt to help adjust for that by spawning in more fruit - either the four common vanilla forage fruit, or any item that is produced by a fruit tree. Inspired by but very different from Better FarmCave Forage, which uses FTM to spawn in a selection of various fruits.

Any fruit tree's products can be spawned. Mod trees, as long as they're registered with [font=Courier New]Data/fruitTrees[/font], will be used as well. (Tested with RSV and PPJA More Trees). Fruit not associated with a tree will not be produced.

[size=5]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12932]AtraCore[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Multiplayer[/size]
Host should install mod. Mod does not do anything for farmhands.

[size=5]SVE compat[/size]
Will also spawn in the MinecartCave and the DeepCave, if [font=Courier New]UseModCaves[/font] is enabled (after 1.0.8). It goes room by room, so if you don't see spawns in MinecartCave and Deepcave try setting the spawn chance lower and the max daily spawns higher.

[size=5]Known compatability issues:[/size]
I check for [font=Courier New]Game1.MasterPlayer.caveChoice[/font] to see what farm cave you've picked. If you're using a mod that causes that flag to never be set (such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10506]Farm Cave Framework[/url]), this mod will never think the cave is a fruit bat cave. To get around it, you can set either [font=Courier New]Ignore Farm Cave Type[/font] to [font=Courier New]true[/font] or [font=Courier New]Allow Early Farm Cave[/font] to [font=Courier New]true[/font].

Farm Cave Framework is handled seperately - this mod will check to see if that mod's field for cave type contains the word "bat" or "fruit" and assume that it is a fruit cave. It should be compatible now.

[size=5]Configuration:[/size]
Run SMAPI at least once with this mod installed to generate the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font], or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure.

[list=1]
[*][font=Courier New]MaxDailySpawns[/font]: the maximum number of fruit that will spawn.
[*][font=Courier New]SpawnChance[/font]: the percent chance any empty square will spawn a fruit, capped by MaxDailySpawns. (Range: 0-100, where 100 means every unoccupied square will have a fruit)
[*][font=Courier New]TreeFruitChance[/font]: the percent chance any particular spawn will be fruit tree fruit and not common forage. (Range: 0-100, where 100 means every spawn will be a tree fruit)
[*][font=Courier New]IgnoreFarmCaveType[/font]: if true, will spawn fruit in any farm cave (as long as you've seen the cutscene). If false, requires that the fruit cave be selected.
[*][font=Courier New]EarlyFarmCave[/font]: if true, will spawn even before the cutscene is seen.
[*][font=Courier New]UseModCaves[/font]: if true, will spawn fruit in caves added by mods, if they're registered with this mod.
[*][font=Courier New]UseMineCave[/font]: if true, will spawn fruit in the mine cave entrances as well (if [font=Courier New]MaxDailySpawns[/font] is not hit.)
[*][font=Courier New]UseVanillaFruitOnly[/font]: use only the six tree fruit that will appear in the fruit bat cave in vanilla. (Yes, this will exlude mangos and bananas.)
[*][font=Courier New]SeasonalOnly[/font]: limits to just the fruits that are in-season. After all, those bats have to be getting the fruit from somewhere, right?
[*][font=Courier New]AllowAnyTreeProduct[/font]: if true, allows any product found for any fruit tree to be spawned. If false, will only spawn items that are categorized as fruit in the game.
[*][font=Courier New]EdiblesOnly[/font]: If true, will only spawn items with a positive value for edibility. Do note that this field is not always perfect; some items that do not seem like they should be edible have positive values for edibility.
[*][font=Courier New]NoBananasBeforeShrine[/font]: there's an objective in vanilla that requires getting a hold of a banana, which is typically quite hard to do. To avoid trivializing that objective, this setting will prevent bananas from spawning until that objective is complete.
[*][font=Courier New]PriceCap[/font]: Caps the value of the fruit that can be spawned.
[/list]
The console command [font=Courier New]av.fcs.list_fruits[/font] will tell you which tree fruits are available for spawning.
